newsitem.title: FRANCE: Former soldier killed in Corsica.
newsitem.headline: Former soldier killed in Corsica.

text.p: A 72-year-old retired soldier was shot dead outside his home in the southern Corsican town of Propriano overnight but there was no immediate indication that separatist gunmen were involved, police said on Sunday.
Jean-Francois Paoli was killed by several shotgun blasts when he went outside his home to investigate suspicious noises outside, police said.
A bomb blast caused moderate damage to a clothing shop several hours later in the north Corsican town of Bastia, police said. No one was hurt.
There was no indication who was responsible for that attack but clandestine separatist groups have carried out many similar bombings this year on the volatile French Mediterranean island.
The SNCM shipping line, the main sealink between Corsica and the French mainland, meanwhile cancelled all sailings to and from the island because of a blockade of its ports by Corsican fishermen.
The blockade, to protest against a free economic zone project, began in several Corsican ports last Tuesday but hardened to include all the island's harbours this weekend.
The fishermen however lifted the blockade twice to allow cargo vessels carrying fruit exports from the island to leave for mainland markets.
